# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal reflections on quitting a comfortable tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and create meaningful work.

## Other

- [Claude Surf Development Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, Linear integration, and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color wheels, harmony schemes, perceptual spaces, and design principles.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canals to invasion novels to spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed exploration of sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial movements.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits similar to human speech.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online mapping.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage, and how glowing jellyfish revolutionized biological research.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How a Tokyo boy's insect collecting inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of development.
- [Pokémon Competitive Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built competitive Pokémon's ruleset through datamining hidden mechanics and community consensus.
- [Pokémon Red Blue Generation One Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous bugs in Pokémon Red and Blue including MissingNo., the unreachable truck, and the Mew glitch.
